name: Chatty Mule 100
author: sheptalo
description: Yellow button that scales up on hover with a smooth transition.
howItWorks: On hover, text color changes to #4e4e4e, border becomes 2px solid #ffff00, transform becomes scale(1.2).
combined:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Chatty Mule 100</title>
<style>
/* Chatty Mule 100 by sheptalo — https://uiverse.io/sheptalo/chatty-mule-100 */
button {
  border-style: outset;
  font-weight: 1000;
  height: 50px;
  width: 150px;
  background: inherit;
  border: 7px solid orange;
  transition: all 900ms;
}

button::before {
  content: "";
  z-index: -1;
  position: absolute;
  left: 50%;
  top: 0;
  bottom: 0%;
  height: 100%;
  width: 0;
  background-color: yellow;
  transition-timing-function: ease-in;
  transition: all 1.3s;
}

button:hover {
  color: rgb(78, 78, 78);
  border: 2px solid yellow;
  transform: scale(1.2);
}

button:hover::before {
  left: 0%;
  width: 100%;
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<button>
  HOVER ME!
</button>

</body>
</html>
